scope: Diagnosis only. Deployed model weights, 12 layers, attention semantics, three-thread server and settings unchanged. Fixed 115-token single-question input, concurrency 1. No response cache, no reverse engineering.
instrumentation_caution: Hooked attribution is about 900ms vs unhooked about 851-869ms. Do not present these phase figures as an exact partition of the earlier 859ms LAN sample. Runtime wall includes vendor SDK scheduling/synchronization, not pure NPU device compute.

scan_microprofile.caution: TorchDispatch adds about 76ms across six scan traces. Operator figures are localization evidence, not an additive raw request-time budget. All six outputs bitwise equal.

interleaved_parallel_probe.scope: Interleaved two-MatMul probe, real M115 K1024 N3584. CPU 4-7. Five warmup rounds, 30 timed rounds per variant, rotating order. No Python output scanning between rounds. Not a d3 model speedup.

core_capability.caution: Separate contexts can overlap. About 1.45x is the two-matrix microbenchmark gain vs serial split-core; about 1.10x is incremental vs same-core concurrent. This does not establish a 1.45x whole-model gain or fully attribute improvement to physical-core execution. Initial sequential-case A53 probe was unstable and is retained.

counterfactuals.assumptions: Only these two categories removed, same serial topology and all other phases unchanged. An idealized accounting exercise, not a forecast or hardware lower bound.

next_candidates.change: Fuse BF16->FP16 conversion with finite/overflow validation directly into reusable RKNN A buffers; convert C FP32->BF16 with identical rounding before leaving own bridge.
next_candidates.evidence: Finite validation ~74ms; input conversion ~26ms; adapter output/self ~63ms; explicit input/output copy ~35ms; allocation ~6ms.
next_candidates.required_checks: Preserve BF16 rounding, NaN/Inf and FP16-overflow errors, noncontiguous tensors, unsupported dtype/shape fallback and buffer lifetime. No disabled checks or result cache.

next_candidates.change: Schedule independent projections within one layer using public MatMul contexts; compare same-core concurrency, split-core concurrency, and concatenated projections.
next_candidates.evidence: Interleaved real-shape paired MatMul test 5.62ms serial ->3.89ms split concurrent; 30/30 rounds faster, exact output. Same-core concurrent already4.28ms.
next_candidates.required_checks: Actual D3 output parity across original seven cases, input reuse safety, model main-thread lifecycle and CPU thread contention. Layer-to-layer dependencies remain serial.

next_candidates.change: Specialize CPU GatedDeltaNet prefill: fuse normalization/scaling/padding and layout conversions, then optimize small batched FP32 matrix multiplies.
next_candidates.evidence: Six scans about248-255ms. Main operator hotspot is18 small batched matrix multiplies; six triangular solves are only about24-27ms.
next_candidates.required_checks: Keep causal scan, full attention visibility, zero initial state, long-input/state fallback, masking and dtype boundaries. Do not assume scan matmuls are independent of previous layers.

two_hundred_ms_conclusion: Another about4.3x is required from the 859ms deployed baseline. There is substantial work in own CPU/bridge code, but 200ms is unproven; current synchronous Runtime wall alone is about199ms. All major categories and NPU scheduling must improve together.

service_preservation.scope: Final verification after all isolated profiling/capability probes completed; existing service never stopped or reconfigured.

additional_latency_observation.interpretation: One first production request after an isolated test measured1.136s; retain it. Cause was not isolated. Previous warm100/100<1s does not imply idle/recovery/long-term hard latency guarantee.

tests_reused: Existing164 operator checks / seven-case model regression not rerun; no math/model optimization deployed. New tests cover instrumentation equality, six actual scan inputs, public core-mask behavior, concurrent contexts, and production preservation.
